symptoms: Small yellow to orange spots or streaks appear on the leaves.
These spots grow into long spindle shapes.
The spots have a pinkish border around them.
The disease can cause heavy damage to the seed stalks.
favourable_conditions: Warm weather with high humidity and long periods of wet leaves for 16 hours or more help the disease grow.
prevention: Soak onion seeds in hot water at 50 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes.
Plant resistant varieties like Welsh onion.
Rotate your crops with plants that do not get this disease.
Keep the field well drained and do not plant too close together.
practices: Collect and burn all old crop parts left in the field.
Make sure the field has good drainage.
Reduce the number of plants in the field to lower density.
